title: Blockchain Smart Contract Testing — Foundry Example
title_es: Testing de Smart Contracts en Blockchain — Ejemplo con Foundry
description: Minimal, runnable Foundry project for smart contract testing: unit tests, fuzz tests, a reentrancy-attacker contract and gas benchmarks against a deposit/withdraw vault.
description_es: Proyecto Foundry mínimo y ejecutable para testing de smart contracts: tests unitarios, fuzz tests, un contrato atacante de reentrancy y benchmarks de gas sobre un vault de depósito/retiro.
